expectations.text: Uses the JSON task file as the source (json tracker) and does not require or point to beads
expectations.evidence: Scope: 'The source is the JSON task file tasks/prd.json ... there is no .beads/'; 'the run then uses --prd <worktree>/tasks/prd.json'

expectations.text: Lists the 12 stories in dependency order (a linear chain US-001 to US-012)
expectations.evidence: 'US-001 export_jobs migration -> US-002 ... -> US-012 finance docs', 'Each one depends on the one before it'

expectations.text: Flags that the quality gates cannot run in this checkout (toolchain not installed)
expectations.evidence: Gap 1: 'npm run typecheck, lint and test all exit 127 (tsc: not found)'

expectations.text: Flags that there is no git remote and what that blocks
expectations.evidence: Gap 2: 'No git remote. No pull request strategy is possible yet'

expectations.text: Flags that the stories' acceptance criteria ("<title> works") cannot be checked
expectations.evidence: 'Each one's main criterion is "<title> works" ... None of the 12 stories has acceptance criteria a subagent can check'

expectations.text: States that ralph-tui rewrites tasks/prd.json during the run and what that means for commits or the working tree
expectations.evidence: Commits: 'as configured the run would produce no commits and would leave tasks/prd.json modified'; with auto-commit 'each carrying that story's passes: true change in tasks/prd.json'

expectations.text: Does not treat branchName as a branch ralph-tui will create; proposes the branch itself following the project's convention (feat/<topic>) or says why not
expectations.evidence: Gap 4: 'branchName is ralph/billing-export ... ralph-tui never checks out branchName. Fix: use feat/billing-export'

expectations.text: Plans to start ralph-tui headless with --prd pointing at the task file (not --epic and not the interactive picker)
expectations.evidence: Mentions '--prd <worktree>/tasks/prd.json' but never states a start command or headless mode; 'headless' and 'ralph-tui run' do not appear in the response

expectations.text: Presents delivery options without picking, recommending or defaulting to one, and asks the user to choose
expectations.evidence: 'Delivery strategy: you choose. I won't pick one.' lists None/One PR/Grouped/Per story; 'Reply with: a delivery strategy'

expectations.text: Proposes an iteration budget above 12 and states the headroom
Sends one plan for confirmation and does not start ralph-tui
expectations.evidence: 'I haven't started ralph-tui'; 'I won't start until I have both'

expectations.text: Leaves the project unchanged (no files edited, tasks/prd.json untouched)
expectations.evidence: actions: only read commands in the project; 'No files in the project were created or modified' (no final git status check recorded, but no write commands listed)
